Frequently Asked Questions

What’s included in Parsley's Complete Care membership?

Complete Care is an annual functional medicine program that pairs you with a dedicated clinician for ongoing medical care throughout the year.

Membership includes 5 provider visits, access to advanced diagnostics — like in-depth lab testing (billed to insurance) or specialty tests — a personalized care plan, functional nutrition coaching visits, and exclusive perks. Your care team, led by your board-certified clinician, supports you in establishing, implementing, and adjusting your care plan as your health evolves.
